Striking one hand on the other or on a solid object and stomping the foot were symbolic actions by which Ezekiel would show anger and grief about what the people of Israel had done and about the judgment that was coming on them. If it would be helpful in your language, you could use an equivalent expression or plain language. Alternate translation: [from the southern border to the northern border]

The word **Diblah** seems to be another spelling of the town “Riblah,” which is located in the far north. Some manuscripts have “Riblah,” here, and some modern translations use that spelling. If a translation of the Bible exists in your region, you may wish to use the reading that it uses.
See how you translated the similar phrase, “you will know that I am Yahweh,” in [verse 7](../06/07.md).
